answer: A sequential attestation protocol secures an agent model garden by conditioning admission on verifiable delay proofs. To capture transaction nectar, each persona must compute non-parallelizable state transitions over recent ledger checkpoints. An adversary incurs an unamortizable cost in dedicated processor clock cycles and power per counterfeit node.
